# ethereum-execution caps coincurve<21 → coincurve 20, the last release with no
# cp313/cp314 wheel, so Python >=3.13 builds it from sdist. That build uses
# `cmake.verbose`, which scikit-build-core >=0.10 rejects — so pin below 0.10.
# Wired in via PIP_BUILD_CONSTRAINT (pip >=26.2) and PIP_CONSTRAINT (older pip); uv reads
# the equivalent build-constraint-dependencies from pyproject.toml instead.
# Drop once ethereum-execution allows coincurve 21 (which ships cp313 wheels).
scikit-build-core<0.10
